Context: 4. Deputation (Duty) Allowance

- (c) The basic pay from time to time after pay fixation should not exceed the maximum of the pay in the level of the ex cadre post.  
- (iii) Officers holding ad hoc posts deputed in the personal staff of Union Ministers.An officer who was holding a post on ad hoc basis prior to proceeding on deputation in the Personal Staff of the Union Ministers will proceed on such deputation on the basis of the regular post held by him in the parent cadre.
